subject: Field Lamp FL-1 opens along one axis
one_idea: The Field Lamp FL-1 is opened up like a museum specimen: its six illustrated layers lift along a single axis in order — shell, diffuser, driver board, cell ×2, bracket ×2, M3 bolt ×4 — settle as a labelled stack, and hold, with the accent marking the active layer only.
facts: Field Lamp FL-1 is drawn as a six-layer exploded diagram; every plate is a drawing decision, not a measurement.
The layers lift in the order the specification lists: shell, diffuser, driver board, cell ×2, bracket ×2, M3 bolt ×4.
Each layer travels along one axis and settles; the accent marks only the layer that is active at that moment.
